mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, password, email, name, role, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{email}, #{name}, #{role}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET username = #{username}, password = #{password}, email = #{email}, name = #{name}, role = #{role}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
